user_intent: A single wide-angle architectural shot of a modern Kay-Twelve learning space showing all three RSC zones simultaneously — high-energy collaboration (left), transition zone (center), and low-energy focus (right). Editorial, ultra-clean, bright natural light. No clutter.

subject.pose: standing, leaning forward over table, one hand pointing at project materials

subject.description: elementary school student, standing across the same tall collaborative table, holding a marker, gesturing mid-explanation to a peer
subject.pose: standing, holding marker up, mid-gesture as if explaining an idea

subject.description: elementary school student, walking through the center of the room, pushing a lightweight mobile chair with both hands, transitioning between zones
subject.pose: walking, both hands gripping a lightweight mobile chair, pushing it toward the right side of the room

subject.description: elementary school student, seated in a low soft accent chair, reading a book, fully absorbed, legs tucked slightly
subject.pose: seated deeply in soft chair, knees slightly bent, holding a book open with both hands, eyes down reading

subject.description: elementary school student, seated cross-legged on a low padded floor cushion near a bookshelf, writing in a notebook, head tilted in concentration
subject.pose: seated cross-legged on floor cushion, leaning slightly forward over a notebook, pencil in hand, writing

scene.location: modern open-plan elementary school learning environment with clearly defined spatial zones: LEFT ZONE has tall standing-height collaborative tables with stools, scattered project materials, a whiteboard wall with student work. CENTER ZONE is an open transitional corridor with lightweight mobile chairs and small tables on casters. RIGHT ZONE has low soft seating chairs and floor cushions arranged near a low bookshelf filled with books. The room has polished concrete floors, floor-to-ceiling windows along one wall, white walls with colorful linear accent graphics, and recessed LED lighting supplemented by abundant natural daylight.
